responsibility: Implements the C-family format-string checking engine behind attributes like format and warnings such as -Wformat. It decodes function format attributes, classifies supported format dialects (including GCC diagnostic formats and target extensions), parses format strings, matches conversions against argument tree types, validates format-arg propagation, and emits rich substring-based diagnostics and fixups for mismatches, nonliteral formats, and malformed directives.
same_name_distinction: Checker implementation for format attributes and -Wformat: unlike c-format.h, which defines the descriptor tables, enums, and metadata schema for format kinds and specifiers, this file uses those definitions to decode attributes, parse format strings, validate argument types, and issue diagnostics.
